name: Signal Markers
description: A HUD panel listing every Signal Lamp on the map with its name and live ON/OFF state. Press L to show it. Name a lamp by clicking its row, or turn on Label mode and click the lamp itself. Pin a lamp and it is marked on the minimap whether it is lit or not — a lamp gone dark is the one you most need to find. Names and pins are saved with the world.
author: Matt

enabled.descriptionKey: If this row is visible in Options > Mods, the mod loaded.
